summary: One Major: the pacing ledger, the director tests and golden, and MONTAGE_BEATS read the recorded bundle while the app plays Solar in story time (storyTime via v1/story.ts presented). Comet plays 45.8 s in the app, not the ~60.8 s yardstick; Quasar has 187 beats, not 348. This answers E10-Q1: 19:25Z is moved by story time. Pulsar's 4 guarded montage beats aren't montages in the app, and 2 of Quasar's app montages are unguarded. The targets still hold in the app (Pulsar 288.6 s, Quasar 289.6 s), as do 79 of 83 director cases in story time. Three Minors: E9-Q1 (the hold isn't stuck; the drive played inside its 1.5 s, and a directed beat's one attempt is used up under the documented hold, so no code fix, but the State line and the montage still need correcting); the volley e2e's loose names check (carried, open); the noted-plate fallback against 06 §9 and P-24 (carried, open). One Nit: tests/README omits rising.test. Flakes: solar-dense:295 4/4 and devlog pass; perf's seek check is red (328 ms) and predates block E.

answers.E10-Q1: The app presents Solar bundles in story time (src/renderer/src/v1/story.ts presented → storyTime). The ledger and scheduleOf({}) read the recorded bundle. Story time moves 10422's 19:25Z event, so the app has no such beat. Same root as the carried ledger-vs-app Quasar mismatch (finding 1).
answers.E9-Q1: Not stuck. The hold releases 1.5 s after the pointerup. The drive pressed play inside that window, and directBeat/fireShot use up their once-per-beat attempt while held (05 §6 item 1, documented). A real click within 1.5 s before a directed beat drops that shot, by design. Fix the drive step and the State line, not cameraHeld (finding 2).

limitations: No full e2e suite, gallery or build run. Finding 1's app numbers come from drive probes on this machine (America/Los_Angeles); in another zone the app's days differ again.
I didn't drive the two app-only Quasar montage beats to see that they draw their notes; E5c's round-2 per-beat sweep found every noted Quasar beat drawn at that time.

Comet's E5 '5% of measured' claim wasn't re-measured in story time against an E4d-state baseline; from the start commit to HEAD, Comet falls by a similar share either way (−9.7% recorded, −9.0% story).
